dashboard.label: Walking Fortress - SOC Operational & KPI Executive Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real-time metrics tracking detection latency (MTTD), automated containment SLA (MTTR), and MITRE ATT&CK technique coverage.

search.query: index=win_telemetry sourcetype="sysmon" OR sourcetype="WinEventLog" | eval detection_latency = _time - _indextime | stats avg(detection_latency) as avg_mttd | eval avg_mttd = round(avg_mttd, 2) . "s"

single.title: Mean Time To Contain (MTTR - SOAR SLA)

search.query: index=soar_logs sourcetype="auto_responder" | stats avg(containment_duration_seconds) as avg_mttr | eval avg_mttr = round(avg_mttr, 2) . "s"
index=win_telemetry OR index=cloud_telemetry severity="CRITICAL" | stats count

chart.title: Alert Volume by Severity Over Time

search.query: index=win_telemetry OR index=cloud_telemetry | timechart count by severity

index=win_telemetry OR index=cloud_telemetry mitre_id="*" | stats count earliest(_time) as FirstSeen latest(_time) as LastSeen by mitre_id rule_name host | convert ctime(FirstSeen) ctime(LastSeen) | sort - count
